Features
• Gently tapered fit
• Semi-spread collar
• Open placket
• Elongated bottom ribbing
Cotton Mouliné
For our warm-weather knits we turned to Italy’s premier cotton yarn maker—an industry leader in sustainable water usage and dyeing practices—to create this special cotton mouliné. The varied coloration and visual texture are the result of twisting together three yarns unique in color but identical in quality. Perfect for the warmer seasons, the fabric has a beautiful bounce and a smooth, crisp hand that’s cool to the touch.
Slow Knitting
Our sweaters are carefully knit on hand-operated machines by artisans with over 50 years of experience on these exact instruments. A slower, manual process compared to the modern high-frequency knitting beds, every step is meticulously monitored by the knitters. Special attention and care ensure that the precious yarn is not overly stressed during the process, retaining its superlative natural properties.
